opportunities.title: [bounty $400] Implement ABNF-compliant email address parser with full §3.2–§4.4 coverage
opportunities.summary: `source.md` contains the complete RFC 5322 specification (Internet Message Format). We need a **fully conformant email address parser** in Python that implements the complete ABNF grammar from sections 3.2 through 3.4, plus obsolete syntax from §4.4. This parser must handle every edge case defined in the RFC — not just simple `user@domain` patterns, but the full complexity of quoted strings, comments, folding whitespace, group addresses, and domain literals. ## Background RFC 5322 defines email address syntax through a chain of ABNF productions that build on each other: ``` address = mailbox / group mailbox = name-addr / addr-spec name-addr = [display-name] angle-addr angle-addr = [CFWS] "<" addr-spec ">" [CFWS] addr-spec = local-part "@" domain local-part = dot-atom / quoted-string / obs-local-part domain = dot-atom / domain-literal / obs-domain ``` Each of these references further productions (CFWS, FWS, quoted-pair, dtext, etc.) that span multiple sections. **You must read `source.md` completely** to trace the full grammar dependency chain. ## Requirements ### 1. opportunities.title: NPC kill rewards: apply overhit XP bonus and OVER-HIT message
opportunities.summary: ## Gap The live NPC death-reward path grants the base single-attacker XP/SP share, but it has no overhit state check, bonus XP, or `OVER_HIT` client message. `internal/gameserver/data/manager/npcs_rewards.go:142-160` calls `player.KillRewardExpAndSp` at line 147, applies the pet split, then immediately calls `RewardExpAndSp` at line 159. A repository search found no Go overhit implementation. ## Java contract In the solo reward path, `Monster.java:158-163` checks `_overhitState.isValidOverhit(attacker)`, sends `SystemMessageId.OVER_HIT`, and adds `calculateOverhitExp(exp)`. The party path does the same at `Monster.java:229-234`. `OverhitState.java:39-65` records a successful overhit only when the enabled overhit hit deals positive lethal excess damage; `OverhitState.java:82-95` calculates the bonus from excess damage, capped at 25% of normal XP and rounded. `OverhitState.java:102-105` requires the recorded attacker to be the rewarded player. ## Scope Port the missing overhit state/trigger and apply this caller-side contract before the pet XP split: - when the rewarded attacker has valid overhit state, send the `OVER_HIT` system message and add the capped, rounded XP bonus; - retain
